top_slide.title: Top Slide
top_slide.description:
Controls the density tapering that happens at the top of the world to prevent terrain from reaching too high

Properties:
• enabled (boolean)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: If false, top slide will be disabled. If true, other parameters will be taken into account.
